response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget), event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_avg FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), kept AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.event_avg FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.event_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) AS mean_kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.event_avg, k.event_avg - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.event_avg - m.mean_kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
